title: FAKE RARE — LIVING PLATE
description: Asset roster, rotation order and runtime for the living plate. The banner turns every six hours through 501 places — the artist's own FAKE ン RARE, then all 500 names — and comes home every 125.25 days. The seal carries the block each asset was issued in. The sweatshirt turns over every 24 hours between the artist's F and his C.

ranking.basis: estimated value in USD per unit
ranking.note: Ranked per-unit, not by market cap. The two differ sharply: FAKEASF leads on market cap (~$795k) but sits mid-pack per unit.
ranking.roster_source: pepe.wtf /api/assets — collectionName 'Fake Rares' (904 records; carries no price data)

excluded.reason: numeric asset id, excluded from the banner as it is not a name

known_gaps.note: Closed. tokenscan.io/api/issuances carries a first-issuance record for every one of the 500, so no asset is missing a date or a block.

runtime.rotation_rule: slot = ((floor((now - genesis) / 6h)) mod 501 + 501) mod 501. Slot 0 is the artist's own FAKE ン RARE, restored from the untouched painting. Slots 1..500 are rotation_order below. Deterministic — the same everywhere, forever.
runtime.sweatshirt_rule: day = floor((now - genesis) / 24h). The chest carries the artist's C when the day is odd AND the banner is not at slot 0; otherwise it carries his F. So the home plate is the untouched original in both places at once — his line on the banner, his F on the chest — and the first 24 hours after genesis read FAKE RARE before the first turn to CAKE. Neither letter is generated: both are his paint.
contains: the seal carrying that asset's issuance block
runtime.lettering: The banner is hand-lettered in capitals throughout, as the artist lettered it. banner_text on each asset is exactly what the brush paints — name.toUpperCase() — so the one subasset, NOFAPPEPE.crema, is painted NOFAPPEPE.CREMA while name keeps its canonical Counterparty form.

banner_field_px.note: Measured off the painting. Every one of the 500 names is laid out inside 1780px and clamped to it; verified pixel by pixel — all 500 paint wholly inside the red field, widest line 1830px of 1898, tallest 268px of 306.

runtime.seal_rule: The seal carries the Bitcoin block each Fake Rare was issued in — issuance_block on that asset — so it turns over with the banner, every six hours. At slot 0 there is no asset and no number: the home plate is the painting alone. Nothing is polled; the artwork makes no network request at all.
runtime.issuance_source: tokenscan.io/api/issuances/{asset}, taking the earliest block_index — the transaction that created the asset on Counterparty. Counterparty rides on Bitcoin, so these are Bitcoin block heights: a sample of seven was checked against mempool.space and every timestamp matched to the second.

artwork.note: This file carries the artwork entire. media[] holds every picture in it; renderer holds the page that moves them. Substitute the four tokens named in renderer.assemble and you have the living plate, byte for byte.
artwork.composition: The painting is the whole image: gold frame to gold frame, no ground around it and nothing cropped from it. Its native proportion is 2:3, so reaching 5:7 takes a 7.14% horizontal stretch, applied evenly to the plate and to all three live layers alike. Every edge of the artist's own frame is present.

base_plate.what: the painting itself, edge to edge, with the banner lettering matted out

fabric.what: the cotton under his F, inpainted, with an F-shaped feathered alpha

letter_c.what: his own C, matted off the companion painting and colour-matched to this export

home_plate.what: his own FAKE ン RARE, matted off the untouched original

renderer.assemble: In renderer.base64 (decoded), replace __ART__ with 'data:'+media.base_plate.mime+';base64,'+media.base_plate.base64, and likewise __FABRIC__ from media.fabric, __LETTERC__ from media.letter_c, __HOME__ from media.home_plate. Save as .html and open it.

live_layers.what: the rotating name, or his own line at slot 0
